name: Multi-repo Git
description: Overview of every Git repository in the workspace — changes, diffs, history, branches, stashes, timeline, cross-repo search. Read-only except three deliberate writes: Fetch, Pull (fast-forward only) and per-file Rollback, plus a full PTY terminal (the same shell the host's Terminal tab uses) and resizable panes.

settings.label: Scan depth
settings.hint: How many levels below the workspace root to search for directories containing .git. 1 = direct subdirectories only.

settings.label: Skip directory names
settings.hint: Comma separated; added on top of the built-in skip list (node_modules, target, dist, ...).

settings.label: Auto refresh (seconds)
settings.hint: 0 = no periodic refresh (only on demand and when the view is re-opened).

settings.label: Branch grouping pattern
settings.hint: Workspace tab: how branches are grouped across repositories. Empty (default) groups by the FULL branch name — the same branch name in several services is one group. A regular expression groups by its first capture group instead, e.g. ([0-9a-z]{8,12})__ for feat/ab12cd34__add-thing, or [A-Z]+-\d+ for ticket keys like PROJ-123. Branches that do not match fall back to their full name. Can be overridden per workspace in the view itself.

settings.label: Show only dirty repos by default

scm.toolbar.label: All repos
scm.toolbar.hint: Overview of every Git repository in this workspace
